test.create_query: CREATE TABLE sorted_key_prefix_runs (a String, b String, x UInt64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (a, b)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO sorted_key_prefix_runs SELECT concat('k', toString(sipHash64(intDiv(number, 2) % 1000))), hex(sipHash64(intDiv(number, 2))), number FROM numbers_mt(5000000)
test.create_query: CREATE TABLE sorted_key_prefix_runs_replacing (a String, b String, x UInt64) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree ORDER BY (a, b)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO sorted_key_prefix_runs_replacing SELECT a, b, x FROM sorted_key_prefix_runs SETTINGS optimize_on_insert = 0, max_insert_threads = 1, max_threads = 1
test.query: SELECT DISTINCT a, b FROM sorted_key_prefix_runs FORMAT Null SETTINGS max_threads = 1
SELECT count() FROM sorted_key_prefix_runs AS l INNER JOIN sorted_key_prefix_runs AS r USING (a, b) FORMAT Null SETTINGS join_algorithm = 'partial_merge'
SELECT count() FROM sorted_key_prefix_runs_replacing FINAL FORMAT Null SETTINGS enable_vertical_final = 0, max_threads = 1
